name: Misplaced
storyline:
In 1893, Italy, aboard a train bound for Palermo, a prominent nobleman died under mysterious circumstances.

Ten years after the crime, and after several trials, the true culprit seemed finally within reach. But due to a procedural flaw, the case was sent back for retrial by the Supreme Court in Rome.

Then, a mysterious fire destroyed the case files. The surviving testimonies, tickets, court records, and investigation reports were left scattered and out of order.

You play as the newly appointed retrial judge, tasked with re-archiving the facts from the remaining documents.

Identify their sources, restore their sequence, and put the truth back where it belongs.
summary: Misplaced is an archive-sorting and one-stroke deduction game. Draw files from a shuffled archive, sort them into folder nodes on the board, then match each file to its sub-node. When every file is correctly archived, solve the one-stroke puzzle to link the clues and restore the truth.
